preservation_script:
import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
node=re.compile(rb'("node"\s*:\s*)"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"')
for f in ('block','utxo','chain','finality','mempool'):
 p=Path(f'corpus/chain/{f}/{f}.jsonl');old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:'+str(p)])
 assert node.sub(rb'\1"<node>"',old)==node.sub(rb'\1"<node>"',p.read_bytes()),p
print('family preservation: GREEN [X] ([M] 442 rows; every non-node byte unchanged against origin/main)')
def fence(s):return json.loads(re.search(r'```json\n(.*?)\n```',s,re.S)[1])
def clear(j):
 if isinstance(j,dict):return {k:clear(v) for k,v in j.items() if k!='node'}
 if isinstance(j,list):return [clear(v) for v in j]
 return j
def mask_trigger(s):
 # Remove only the R2 trigger object's span, preserving all other raw bytes.
 pattern=re.compile(r'"trigger"\s*:\s*')
 hits=[]
 for m in pattern.finditer(s):
  obj,n=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s[m.end():]);hits.append((m.end(),m.end()+n))
 for a,b in reversed(hits):s=s[:a]+'"<R2 trigger>"'+s[b:]
 return s
for p in sorted(Path('corpus/scenarios').glob('2026-10-12-*.md')):
 old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:'+str(p)]).decode();cur=p.read_text()
 # Ensure amendment content is exactly the previously reviewed c-lane tree.
 reviewed=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/lane/fix-66:'+str(p)]).decode()
 assert cur==reviewed,p
 a,b=clear(fence(old)),clear(fence(cur))
 def remove_triggers(j):
  if isinstance(j,dict):return {k:remove_triggers(v) for k,v in j.items() if k!='trigger'}
  if isinstance(j,list):return [remove_triggers(v) for v in j]
  return j
 assert remove_triggers(a)==remove_triggers(b),p
 def normalize(s):
  s=node.sub(rb'\1"<node>"',s.encode()).decode()
  s=re.sub(r'measured agree \[X\] docs/records/[^\s`|]+\.md','pending #66',s)
  s=s.replace('`action.trigger` RPC batch','`action.trigger` oracle event')
  return mask_trigger(s)
 assert normalize(old)==normalize(cur),p
print('intake preservation: GREEN [X] ([M] 2 files; only node metadata and the reviewed R2 trigger/prose amendment)')
print('opcode diff: '+('empty [X]' if not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','origin/main','--','spec/opcodes/']) else 'NONEMPTY'))
